executive_summary: SPIG-GMAB is a nearly 90-year-old industrial company (founded 1936) with real global operations across 50+ countries, verified ESWET trade membership, and a notable M&A history (Babcock & Wilcox, AUCTUS Capital Partners). However, the website scored 39/100 on the GEO audit, placing it firmly in the Needs Attention tier. The most severe issues are: (1) zero hreflang implementation across an 8-language site, (2) Lorem ipsum placeholder text on the SPIG brand page, (3) all content authored by a web agency email rather than engineers, and (4) product pages with under 200 words and no technical specifications. The gap between the company's real-world industrial authority and its digital content is the single largest opportunity — fixing hreflang, author attribution, and building technical content could lift the score to 60+ within 90 days.

findings.title: No Hreflang Tags on 8-Language Site
findings.description: Zero hreflang tags across the entire site despite serving content in 8 languages (EN, IT, ES, PT, ZH, AR, SV, DE). No x-default declaration. No lang attribute on HTML elements. Google treats language variants as potential duplicate content. This is the single most damaging technical SEO issue.

findings.title: Lorem Ipsum on SPIG Brand Page
findings.description: The /spig/ brand page contains Lorem ipsum placeholder text visible to AI crawlers and users, severely damaging credibility.

findings.title: Author Attribution is a Web Agency Email
findings.description: All blog posts and their schema markup attribute content to multimedia@studiokey.it. The Person schema shows this email as the author name with a generic Gravatar. Zero E-E-A-T value.

findings.title: Zero Technical/Educational Content
findings.description: No content answers industry questions. Product pages under 200 words. Blog has ~10 posts total (many translations of same articles). No comparison tables, FAQ sections, specifications, or performance data.

findings.title: No Service or Product Schema
findings.description: Core service pages (/wet-cooling-towers/, /dry-cooling-systems/) have zero Service or Product schema. Only generic WebPage + Organization + BreadcrumbList boilerplate.

findings.title: No LocalBusiness Schema Despite Multiple Offices
findings.description: Confirmed offices in Italy (Paruzzaro), Sweden (Goteborg), and China have no LocalBusiness schema. Phone numbers and addresses exist on contact page but are not structured.

findings.title: Case Studies Are Stubs
findings.description: The cooling tower installation case study has no client name, no quantified outcomes, no performance data, no photographs. For B2B, detailed case studies are the most important AI-citable content.

findings.title: No llms.txt File
findings.description: No structured guidance for AI crawlers about site content, company identity, or citation preferences.

findings.title: No Canonical Tags Detected
findings.description: Canonical tags not found on tested pages. Critical gap with 8 language versions increasing duplicate content risk.

findings.title: Astra Theme Hooks in Sitemap
findings.description: Sitemap includes internal Astra theme hook URLs that waste crawl budget and expose theme architecture.

findings.title: No Wikipedia/Wikidata Entity
findings.description: Despite 90-year history, M&A paper trail (SEC filings, Power Magazine), and ESWET membership, no Wikipedia article exists. Wikipedia is one of the most heavily weighted sources in LLM training data.

findings.title: No YouTube Presence
findings.description: No installation timelapses, technical explainers, or factory tours. YouTube transcripts feed directly into AI training data.

Implement hreflang tags across all 8 language versions + x-default declaration
Add <html lang="..."> attribute to every page template + dir="rtl" for Arabic
Fix author attribution — replace web agency email with named SPIG engineers

Exclude astra-advanced-hook from sitemap and set to noindex
Register Bing Webmaster Tools and submit sitemap

Pursue Wikipedia article for SPIG — highest-impact single action for LLM training data
Launch YouTube channel with cooling tower installation timelapses and technical explainers

Pursue feature articles in Power Magazine and CTI publications (not just press releases)
Build LinkedIn thought leadership content program with 2+ posts per month
